defects.description: cron-round-6 fix-hipabduct-signs.js detected both hipAbduct same sign and flipped BOTH to -10 (both abducted outward). But the script BUG: for crossed intent it should make signs OPPOSITE (one +, one -), not just negate both. Result: hipAbductL=-10, hipAbductR=-10 (both abducted outward) is WORSE than original (both adducted inward) — neither configuration is crossed. Description requires opposite leg to cross IN FRONT, which needs the crossing leg to adduct (POSITIVE hipAbduct) and swing forward (POSITIVE rightHip).

Description says opposite leg cross casually IN FRONT — requires the crossing leg to swing forward (rightHip positive). Currently rightHip=0 (no forward swing); the right leg never crosses in front, it just abducts outward.

failing_tests.assertion: hipAbduct signs opposite (one +, one -) for crossed-leg description

regression_risk: low — single-pose 3-field change; right leg now crosses in front of left as described
rationale: CORRECTED CONVENTION: hipAbduct + = adduction (inward/cross), - = abduction (outward/spread). leftHip/rightHip + = leg swings FORWARD. Description: opposite leg cross casually in front. With leftShoulder=-8 (body slightly leaned toward left doorframe), the OPPOSITE (right) leg crosses in front. Set hipAbductR=+15 (right leg adducts/crosses inward toward left), rightHip=+18 (right leg swings forward to cross in front of left foot). hipAbductL=-10 keeps left leg slightly abducted (stable base against doorframe). The cron-round-6 fix script had a logic bug (negated both signs instead of making them opposite).
